text: {"lessons":["My account’s early gains were followed by a substantial decline, so I should monitor portfolio risk and have clear reasons for holding positions through downturns.","Selling Stock B and Stock D at losses, then buying Stock B again, shows I need a consistent view of each holding rather than making disconnected trades.","Before adding to a position or selling part of one, consider how the trade changes my overall exposure and keep decisions tied to long-term prospects, not just recent price moves."]}
